axioms.name: Experimental.P03_03.actualMomentFactorialMajorant
axioms.meaning: For each admissible actual manuscript measure, one positive constant and one fixed factorial offset bound every moment.
axioms.supports: Only the analytic growth input to a Stieltjes Carleman argument; not measure uniqueness.

axioms.name: Experimental.P03_03.generalizedVandermondePositive
axioms.meaning: Generalized Vandermonde determinants are positive on strictly increasing positive nodes and strictly increasing natural exponents.
axioms.supports: Only pointwise integrand sign for mixed minors after an independently proved Andreief identity.
